categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Wondux Environmental Protection Technology Corp., Ltd primarily operates in advanced environmental protection technology equipment development, system integration, and comprehensive environmental solutions. Its main business segments focus on organic waste treatment and industrial wastewater treatment, with additional activities in ecological restoration and other wastewater treatment services. The company also engages in BOT and entrusted operation models for environmental projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including high-efficiency anti-fouling MBR membrane systems, intelligent two-stage DTRO membrane technology, electrochemical-biological coupling deep treatment, low-consumption evaporation, high-impact biological wastewater treatment, electrochemical pretreatment for refractory organic pollutants, salt separation and resource recovery, precise leachate drainage and collaborative treatment, in-situ landfill oxygenation stabilization, groundwater remediation and monitoring, and biological conversion of kitchen waste into protein. Production involves modular equipment manufacturing and integrated mobile treatment devices, with strict quality control at key process nodes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include local governments and large industrial enterprises, particularly in sectors such as mining, coal chemical, new energy, petroleum and petrochemical, and municipal environmental services. The company serves domestic markets primarily in North China and East China regions, with plans to expand into international markets leveraging Chery Group's overseas presence. Major projects include landfill leachate treatment, kitchen waste processing, and industrial wastewater zero discharge.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant business concentration in North China and East China regions. It has subsidiaries and projects across multiple provinces including Jiangsu, Tianjin, Shanxi, Anhui, Hebei, Qinghai, and Inner Mongolia. The company plans to expand its environmental services to overseas markets, leveraging strategic partnerships with Chery Group's international operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Wondux operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, focusing on technology development, equipment manufacturing, system integration, project implementation, and operation of environmental treatment facilities. It also extends upstream into resource recycling and green materials development, including lithium extraction from brine and battery recycling technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced wastewater treatment, organic waste resource recovery, and green materials, including lithium extraction and battery recycling. It emphasizes technology iteration, integration of biochemical and physical-chemical processes, and development of low-carbon, energy-efficient solutions aligned with China's dual carbon goals. The company maintains multiple innovation platforms and collaborates with academic and research institutions to enhance its technological capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of environmental protection equipment, system integration services, and comprehensive environmental solutions. Additional income streams include entrusted operation fees, BOT project revenues, and government subsidies. The company recognizes revenue based on contract performance progress or service delivery, with some projects involving long-term investment and operation contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading player in China's environmental protection industry, especially in landfill leachate treatment and industrial wastewater zero discharge sectors. It competes with other large environmental engineering firms and technology providers, leveraging its comprehensive technology portfolio, project experience, and strategic partnerships. It holds several industry awards and certifications, reinforcing its market leadership in specialized niches.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 621.6 million, a 23.24% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.2 million. Despite revenue decline, project gross margin improved by 7.92 percentage points. The company maintains strong cash flow management, with operating cash flow turning positive to RMB 81.9 million. Total assets stood at RMB 2.08 billion, reflecting a slight decrease year-over-year. The company continues to invest in R&D, allocating over 5% of revenue to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Wondux emphasizes its comprehensive environmental solutions integrating advanced proprietary technologies and equipment for wastewater and solid waste treatment. Its unique value lies in the full-process, full-quantity, and full-chain integrated approach to organic waste and wastewater resource recovery, supported by strong R&D capabilities and a skilled technical team. The company differentiates itself through high-efficiency, low-energy consumption technologies, and its ability to provide customized, system-level environmental solutions aligned with national green development policies.
